_comment: Muse Spark on MI355X, TP8/EP8 configs from InferenceX CI run 39659301076. Adopt each config's own CI observations, plan a shared sampling union within identical deployments, then project costs and select operators per config at >3% before taking the union. Each task has one UT retaining per-config weights. Applyback uses the lowest/highest concurrency representatives; profile still accounts for middle configs. One EP group per campaign. Profile and template-based UT generation run as separate stages connected by a hashed evidence handoff.

params.selection: Per config, phase Top 10 complete operators AND whole-workload GPU-time share strictly >3%, then union. Keep required companions and phase branches. Plan compatible shared sampling before capture; retain each config's observed frequencies and uncovered mass.

params._note_point_serving_env: Per representative point id (baseline.json representative): an env file with that config's launch settings (KV offload, speculative decoding, ...). CONC and TP are taken from the point's CI config and win over the file.
